messages.author: 8393b4780d0d6e0b
messages.subject: Problem with dispersal matricies
parts:
Hi,

I'm having huge trouble getting BioGeoBears to understand my dispersal matricies file. I've re-written it multiple times and it's driving me a bit crazy so I'm hoping someone here can help. I've looked through other people's example files and others' problems and tried to fix everything I can see that's wrong but I still keep getting error messages. When I try to load the dispersal matricies using:

BioGeoBEARS_run_object = readfiles_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)

I get 35 warnings. These 35 warnings are all:

In read_dispersal_multipliers_fn(inputs) : NAs introduced by coercion

I have 36 dispersal matricies so I assume it is the same problem for all my dispersal matricies. If I ignore these warnings and go ahead to setting up the DEC model, when I check for error using: 

check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)

I get the following: 

Error in inputs$list_of_dispersal_multipliers_mats[[1]] : 
  subscript out of bounds

This is the first time I've tried to use BioGeoBears so please forgive my ignorance. Also, I'd appreciate answers in English, not R, or binary, as I'm also by no means and R expert...!!

The dispersal matrix file is attached. 

Many thanks in advance,

Susie
